title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements - Emergency Lighting
description: Specifies requirements for emergency luminaires for use with electrical light sources on emergency power supplies not exceeding 1000 V.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Safety Requirements
description: Specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements, together with test methods for LED lamps with integrated means for controlling, intended for domestic and general lighting.

title: Lamp Controlgear - Particular Requirements for DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
description: Specifies particular safety requirements for electronic controlgear for use on DC supplies up to 250 V and AC supplies up to 1000 V at 50 Hz or 60 Hz.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
description: Deals with the safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, their rated voltage being not more than 250 V for single-phase appliances and 480 V for other appliances.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Kitchen Machines (Mixers, Blenders, Food Processors)
description: Deals with the safety of electric kitchen machines including food mixers, blenders, meat mincers, coffee grinders, and citrus fruit squeezers for household use.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Domestic and Similar Purposes of Rated Voltage up to and including 250 Volts and Rated Current up to and including 16 Amperes
description: Applies to plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for AC only, with or without earthing contact, for domestic and commercial installation.

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Specification
description: Specifies requirements for domestic pressure cookers manufactured from aluminium alloys, stainless steel, or composite metals, having capacities between 1 and 20 litres.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
description: Covers requirements of high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
description: Covers the requirements of steel plates, sections, flats, bars and strips for use in structural work subjected to dynamic or static loading.

title: Protective Helmets for Riders of Two Wheeled Motor Vehicles - Specification
description: Specifies requirements regarding construction, finish, mass, retention system, and protective capability of helmets for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.

title: Electric Power Driven Vehicles - Lithium-Ion Based Traction Battery Systems - Safety Requirements
description: Specifies safety requirements and validation tests for lithium-ion secondary cells and battery packs intended for traction power in pure electric and hybrid road vehicles.

title: Electric Vehicle Conductive AC and DC Charging Systems - General Requirements
description: Applies to on-board and off-board equipment for charging electric road vehicles at standard AC supply voltages up to 1000 V and DC voltages up to 1500 V.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (33, 43 and 53 Grades)
description: Covers the manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of ordinary Portland cement of 33, 43, and 53 grades for general and heavy civil engineering construction.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification (Part 1: Fly Ash Based)
description: Covers manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of fly ash based Portland pozzolana cement for masonry, plastering, and general concrete structures.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
description: Prescribes requirements, methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking water filled into hermetically sealed containers of various capacities.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
description: Prescribes requirements and test protocols for packaged natural mineral water obtained directly from underground sources or springs and packaged at source.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
description: Applies to all toys intended for children under 14 years, establishing criteria for sharp edges, points, small parts (choking hazard), and mechanical strength.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 2: Flammability
description: Specifies categories of flammable materials prohibited in all toys and requirements concerning flammability of toys when subjected to small ignition sources.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements
description: Specifies maximum acceptable levels and methods of extraction for bioavailable lead, cadmium, antimony, arsenic, barium, chromium, mercury, and selenium from toy materials.

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
description: Applicable to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including electronic business equipment and telecommunication equipment.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Lithium Cells
description: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries containing non-acid electrolyte under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
description: Lays down requirements for the design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules suitable for long-term operation in open-air climates.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
description: Specifies the fineness of gold alloys used for manufacture of jewellery and artefacts, together with statutory hallmarking requirements and consumer purity standards.

title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
description: Prescribes requirements for fineness and hallmarking identification of silver jewellery and artefacts manufactured in India.

title: Polyethylene for its Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water
description: Specifies requirements and methods of sampling and test for polyethylene plastic materials for manufacture of containers, films, and piping intended to come into contact with foodstuffs.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: Domestic Stainless Steel Sinks - Specification
description: Specifies performance, dimensional, and anti-corrosion requirements for stainless steel sinks for domestic and institutional kitchens.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies
description: Specifies requirements for unplasticized PVC (uPVC) pressure pipes for conveyance of potable water, including dimensional tolerances, hydraulic characteristics, and chemical resistance.
technical_department: Polymer and Rubber Products Sectional Committee (PCD)

title: Methods of Test for Thermoplastics Pipes, Fittings and Valves - Part 5: Determination of Resistance to Internal Pressure
description: Specifies test method for determining the resistance to internal hydrostatic pressure of thermoplastic pipes including HDPE, PVC, and PP pipes used in water supply and sewerage systems.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: Gas Cylinders — Transportable Refillable Metallic Gas Cylinders
description: Covers requirements for transportable refillable metallic gas cylinders including LPG cylinders for domestic use, industrial cylinders, and CNG storage cylinders.

title: LPG Pressure Regulators
description: Specifies requirements for pressure regulators fitted on domestic LPG cylinders including construction, materials, testing, and performance requirements.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: Domestic Non-Pressure Cookers (Aluminium)
description: Specifies requirements for aluminium non-pressure cookers used for domestic cooking at atmospheric pressure, including material composition, wall thickness, and lid requirements.

title: Domestic Gas Cooking Ranges - Specification
description: Specifies constructional and performance requirements for domestic gas cooking ranges, gas stoves, and hot plates designed to use liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) or town gas.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: Fire Hoses - Lay Flat Type Delivery Hose — Specification
description: Specifies requirements for lay-flat delivery hose used in fire fighting applications including pressure rating, burst pressure, coupling dimensions, and water flow requirements.

title: Fire Extinguishers — Portable — Selection and Installation
description: Provides guidance on selection and installation of portable fire extinguishers in various premises including industrial, commercial, and residential buildings.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers — Dry Powder (Stored Pressure) Type
description: Specifies requirements for portable dry powder type fire extinguishers (ABC and BC types) including construction, powder fill, pressure, discharge, and marking requirements.

title: Colours for Ready Mixed Paints and Enamels
description: Specifies 101 standardised colours for ready-mixed paints and enamels including safety colour codes (red for fire equipment, yellow for caution markings, green for safety/first aid). Used in pipework colour coding and industrial safety markings across India.

title: Hardened Concrete — Methods of Test — Part 1: Testing of Strength of Concrete
description: Specifies methods for sampling and testing hardened concrete for compressive strength (cube test), tensile strength (split cylinder), and flexural strength (beam test) as required for structural conformity assessment.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification
description: Specifies requirements for coarse and fine aggregates obtained from natural sources, manufactured crushed stone, and recycled aggregates for use in concrete.

title: Sand for Plaster — Specification
description: Specifies requirements for natural sand and crushed stone sand used in plastering, mortaring, and masonry applications in construction.

title: Low Density Polyethylene Films — Specification
description: Specifies requirements for low density polyethylene (LDPE) films used in packaging, covering thickness, tensile strength, elongation, dart impact, and optical properties.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: High Density Polyethylene Materials for Moulding and Extrusion — Specification
description: Specifies requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) materials used in moulding and extrusion applications, including melt flow index, density, tensile properties, and impact strength.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification
description: Specifies requirements for natural mineral water collected at source, including mineral composition limits, microbiological standards, packaging requirements, and labelling. Distinguishes mineral water from processed packaged drinking water.

title: Ceiling and Pedestal Fans — Specification
description: Specifies requirements for ceiling fans, pedestal fans, wall fans, and table fans for household use, covering motor performance, capacitor specifications, blade dimensions, vibration, safety, and energy efficiency ratings.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
description: Specifies requirements for PVC insulated and sheathed cables used in fixed or flexible domestic and industrial wiring, rated up to 1100 V including conductor material, insulation thickness, and current ratings.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing (with Amendment No.1 to 3)
description: Provides a code of practice for earthing (grounding) of electrical installations in buildings, including earthing electrode types, earthing conductors, earth resistance requirements, and testing procedures.

title: Miniature Circuit Breakers for Overcurrent Protection of Household and Similar Installations
description: Specifies requirements for miniature circuit breakers (MCBs) for rated voltages up to 440 V AC and rated currents up to 125 A, used in distribution boards for household and commercial wiring.

title: Residual Current Operated Circuit Breakers Without Integral Overcurrent Protection (RCCB) for Household and Similar Uses
description: Specifies requirements for residual current circuit breakers (RCCBs) for household use including rated operating current, breaking capacity, sensitivity, and test methods for 16 A to 125 A ratings.

title: Extension Cords and Cord Sets for Household and Similar Purposes
description: Specifies requirements for extension cords with single and multiple socket outlets for household and similar use, covering current rating, conductor cross-section, protection class, and marking.

title: Protective Clothing for Use against Liquid Chemicals - Performance Requirements for Chemical Protective Suits Providing Protection to the Full Body
description: Specifies minimum performance requirements for chemical protective suits providing liquid-tight (Type 3) or spray-tight (Type 4) protection to the full body of the wearer.

title: Safety of Domestic LPG Appliances — Gas Cooking Stoves
description: Specifies safety requirements for domestic LPG stoves and gas hobs including burner efficiency, thermocouple safety device, spill-over testing, and materials in contact with food grade gas.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: Water Heaters — Domestic Electric Instantaneous Type
description: Specifies requirements for domestic electric instantaneous water heaters (geysers) including safety, insulation, temperature cut-off, pressure vessel integrity, and energy consumption.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
description: Specifies requirements for armoured and unarmoured PVC insulated and sheathed heavy-duty cables for wiring in industrial installations, rated up to 1100 V.

title: Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings — Part 1: Mild Steel Tubes
description: Specifies requirements for mild steel tubes for general purposes including water, gas, steam, and air supply in industrial and domestic applications, covering grades (light, medium, heavy), tolerances, and testing.

title: Solar Flat Plate Collector — Requirements
description: Specifies minimum requirements for solar flat plate collectors used in domestic solar water heating systems, including absorber plate material, glazing, insulation, frame, and thermal performance testing.
